notes: Bytes are complete JS/MJS/CSS artifacts, gzip level 9 per file. Each total and file size was independently recomputed.
Ordinary and Bridge browser timing is navigation/preparation to actual App effect, not isolated React-only hydration CPU.
All three revisions use the identical harness and build flags. All three frozen lockfiles are identical. Cookie remains at its original version with no compatibility wrapper.
Legacy engine uses external Provider and deep-merged plugin context. Unified engines use one canonical context. Legacy lacks isolated ordinary-owner and disposal contracts.
Live synthetic memory retains 1000 owners after GC, eight plugins, empty routes and no DOM. This is not memory for 1000 mounted Bridge apps.
Raw response HTML, streams, process inventories, failure logs and full warmups remain in the local evidence package. Public data omits machine paths and process lists.

Compact concurrent/browser rows use the declared columns. Full per-file inventories, per-plugin marks and server module inventories remain in local raw evidence. Inventory fingerprints use Python json.dumps(sort_keys=True) over captured file rows.
